summary: Nuveen Churchill BDC V (the Fund) filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its sale of substantially all assets to Nuveen Churchill Private Capital Income Fund (PCAP) on May 1, 2026. The purchase price was $346,954,197, equal to the Fund's NAV as of April 29, 2026, with PCAP assuming $511 million in debt. PCAP funded the price via credit facility borrowings. The boards and Fund shareholders approved the transaction under Rule 17a-8. The affiliates are managed by Nuveen entities. The deal eliminates the BDC V structure, effectively folding it into PCAP. Watch for shareholder distributions and remaining liabilities.
